body:
### Neovim 0.12+ is now required

hey there everyone! from now on, we have decided to raise the minimum neovim version to 0.12+ in #3588. this also applies when using WSL or connecting to a remote neovim server. If you need an older neovim version, use an earlier Neovide release that supports it.

## Features

- feat: support neovim :connect by @falcucci in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3614
- macOS: add a custom native Editors window switcher by @falcucci in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3527
- macos: add split-aware scrollbars at both outer window padding by @falcucci in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3589
- handoff: Add neovim-bin and neovim arguments by @CGamesPlay in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3440
- feat: settings for menu shortcuts on macOS by @vapourismo in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3481
- macos: add system window proxy icon support by @falcucci in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3494
- add startup-message capture settings by @falcucci in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3517
- handle neovim bufwrite progress events by @falcucci in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3546

## Bug Fixes

- fix: panicking on zero-height grids by @falcucci in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3487
- fix: track reasonable cmdline modes and reset springs on immediate cursor moves by @falcucci in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3484
- fix: avoid fullscreen on new tab windows if already set by @falcucci in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3496
- fix event loop CPU spin without deadline by @falcucci in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3503
- fix: surface startup errors before first grid - 0.12+ only by @falcucci in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3504
- windows: fix overlapped pipe read crash by @windexlight in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3505
- fix: parsing neovim api function parameters by @onion108 in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3530
- fix: ignore unrelated config directory events by @fzlzjerry in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3545
- fix: render COLRv1 fonts on Linux by @fzlzjerry in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3544
- bridge: handle quit callbacks without an exit code by @falcucci in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3583
- fix: harden neovim restart handling by @BreezeDelegate in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3552
- fix: preserve Windows file drop paths by @BreezeDelegate in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3553
- fix: preserve channel properties across :restart by @falcucci in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3591
- fix: request activation for wayland focus commands by @falcucci in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3592
- fix --wayland-app-id option by @falcucci in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3594
- fix: avoid startup crashes when configured fonts are missing by @falcucci in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3595
- fix: keep grid contents when win_pos reports a stale window size by @SirVer in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3612

## Performance and visual polish

- Cursor Polish by @Kethku in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3543
- batch wheel scrolls by @falcucci in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3562
- fill fractional bottom edge backgrounds by @falcucci in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3572

## Documentation

- update homebrew installation docs. by @falcucci in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3582
- docs: add new :NeovideHelp as immediate forward by @falcucci in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3587
- fix(docs): escape / in autocmd pattern by @pilgrimlyieu in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3570
- docs: add macos opt-in system scrollbars by @falcucci in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3610

## Refactoring

- moving platform window wrapper to sub-mod by @falcucci in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3600
- moving and creating window platform setup sub-mods by @falcucci in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3602
- moving macos window/settings into window platform sub-mods by @falcucci in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3603
- moving macos platform scrollbar to window wrapper by @falcucci in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3604
- moving macos switcher to window wrapper by @falcucci in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3605
- moving platform root into sub-mods by @falcucci in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3606
- moving platform application into sub-mods by @falcucci in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3607
- macos: fix unnecessary wrapper imports and some cleanup by @falcucci in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3608
- wrapper: stop referencing the parent mod on specific cases. by @falcucci in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3609
- chore: move error_handling.rs => errors/mod.rs by @falcucci in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3611

## Build and maintenance

- fix clippy warnings after new rust stable version by @falcucci in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3485
- chore: update rust edition to 2024 by @falcucci in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3489
- bump skia-safe to 0.97 by @falcucci in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3501
- bump skia-safe to 0.97.2 by @falcucci in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3510
- ci: fix AppImage updates for nightly builds by @mareklangiewicz in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3535
- swap the drained vector out using std::mem::take by @falcucci in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3559
- profile scroll command pressure without tracy fibers by @falcucci in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3561
- bump skia-safe to 0.99.0 by @falcucci in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3560
- fix clippy errors from derive-new crate by @falcucci in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3584
- macso: fix entitlements with audio-input access by @falcucci in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3585
- macos: fix YAML sign formatting by @falcucci in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3586
- experimental: bump rust nightly for better fmt and features by @falcucci in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3597
- bump skia-safe 0.156.0 by @falcucci in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3615
- chore: automatic draft release by @falcucci in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3558

## New Contributors

- @vapourismo made their first contribution in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3481
- @windexlight made their first contribution in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3505
- @onion108 made their first contribution in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3530
- @mareklangiewicz made their first contribution in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3535
- @fzlzjerry made their first contribution in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3545
- @dajiaohuang made their first contribution in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3566
- @BreezeDelegate made their first contribution in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3552
- @pilgrimlyieu made their first contribution in https://github.com/neovide/neovide/pull/3570
